alternative_hypothesis: At least one preregistered finite-core energy/dynamical functional is reproducible across independent carriers of the same topology, separates topology classes beyond numerical/source variation, and yields frozen target-free predictions whose post-reveal mass ratios outperform the registered historical/factorized baselines without target-specific fitting.
assumptions: The particle-scale working sector is an incompressible, inviscid, no-external-forcing filament model; reconnection is excluded within a carrier evaluation.

PKLSA/E010 v0.3.x is geometry/provenance authority only; an E010 topology-level failure does not promote a carrier to topology evidence, but individually admissible carriers may still support carrier-specific diagnostics.

The operational v0.1.0 energy kernel is a Rosenhead-regularized slender-filament Hamiltonian. It is a reduced finite-core approximation to the three-dimensional kinetic-energy integral, not an assertion that the two are already identical.
Reach normalization sets the dimensionless core/thickness scale for shape comparison; SI restoration uses r_c only after the dimensionless kernel is frozen.

Reduced variational dynamics use small topology-preserving Bishop-frame perturbations. A nonstationary base state weakens the interpretation of its Hessian/Jacobian but does not prevent their diagnostic computation.
Protected observed masses, identity mappings, and historical numerical comparison targets are inaccessible to BLIND code and outputs.
A scientific FAIL does not imply later gates are meaningless; later gates run independently and carry explicit soft-dependency caveats. Infrastructure/protocol integrity remains fail-closed.
edge_cases: A topology with only one admissible independence group can produce carrier diagnostics but cannot close cross-source replication.
A nonstationary carrier can still yield a Hessian/Jacobian diagnostic; such a spectrum is explicitly not promoted as a stability eigen-spectrum.
Near-zero or negative Hessian eigenvalues may make frequency ratios undefined; these cases remain explicit rather than being regularized into a preferred ratio.
Multicomponent links with negative mutual energy can yield indefinite coherence matrices; signed eigenvalues and absolute-energy participation are both retained.

If a scientific gate fails, later gates still execute unless their own required inputs are mathematically unavailable; the output records a soft-dependency caveat rather than framework-level prerequisite skipping.

falsification_criteria.criterion: No energy kernel attains carrier-level numerical convergence at the preregistered tolerance in any independently sourced topology with at least two admissible groups.
Within-topology variation of the converged energy kernel is not smaller than between-topology variation under the registered variance-ratio discriminator.
C++ FP64 differs from Python FP64 by relative L2 above 1e-10 for the certification kernel.
Registered geometry-plus-spectrum surrogates fail to improve protected topology-holdout energy prediction over the simplest geometry baseline by the preregistered improvement threshold.
A protected post-reveal target comparison may not be promoted if its blind prediction was not present in PREDICTIONS_FROZEN.json produced by the prior FULL/CERTIFY run.

implementation_commitment.rule: Mismatch is an infrastructure/protocol integrity failure and aborts before G0; scientific gate failures remain diagnostic-continuation.

null_hypothesis: After numerical convergence and source-independence controls, no registered energy or spectral functional is stable within topology relative to between-topology variation, and added dynamical descriptors do not improve protected holdout prediction of the finite-core energy kernel beyond simple geometry controls.
objective: Compute geometry, regularized filament energy, interaction coherence, reduced Lagrangian/Hamiltonian closure, Hessian/Jacobian spectra, and target-free surrogate competition on source-native PKLSA carriers. Freeze all topology-level kernels and anonymous composite predictions before any protected target comparison. Scientific gate failures are diagnostic and do not suppress execution of later scientific gates; only protocol/integrity failures are hard blockers.

observables.definition: Within-topology coefficient of variation of each geometry and energy descriptor across admissible carriers.
Resolution/core-law convergence of the regularized line-energy kernel.
Eigenvalues, participation ratio, and spectral entropy of the coherence matrix, plus line-Hamiltonian versus core-tube energy association.
Normalized Euler-Lagrange residual and Hamiltonian drift under short reduced trajectories.
Hessian symmetry, gradient norm, Jacobian spectrum, oscillatory frequencies, and direct-integration spectral consistency.
Protected-holdout log error for geometry-only and geometry-plus-dynamics surrogates of H_hat.
Frozen per-topology dimensionless kernels and SI mass predictions produced before reveal.

predictions: If the historical factorization is a low-resolution surrogate of finite-core dynamics, at least some of its structural roles should reappear as topology-stable energy/coherence/spectral observables without target tuning.

If a universal suppression ratio is genuinely dynamical, a narrow ratio cluster should appear across independently sourced topologies before reveal; otherwise the ratio should be topology-dependent or absent.
If mass information is predominantly energetic, direct regularized Hamiltonian kernels should generalize at least as well as higher-complexity factorized surrogates after complexity penalization.
research_question: Does a source-independent, topology-stable finite-core vortex Hamiltonian and its local variational spectrum provide a lower-complexity reconstruction of the historical SST mass kernel, with frozen blind mass-scale predictions that generalize across independent PKLSA carriers?

steps.operation: Verify E010 release metadata, locate qualification ledgers, reload original carriers, and recheck raw/geometry hashes when available.
Run analytic/synthetic controls, SI scale checks, orientation/rigid-motion/resampling controls.
Compute length, reach-normalized ropelength proxy, curvature, torsion, writhe/linking, Bishop holonomy, and convergence statistics.
Evaluate held-out independent carrier groups without pooling distinct carriers as numerical refinement levels.
Compare C++/pybind11 FP64 regularized energy matrix with Python/NumPy FP64 reference.
Record framework SYCL/DD32 screening evidence separately from certification authority.
Quantify cross-independence-family replication and pseudo-replication exclusions.
Compute self/mutual energy matrices, coherence spectra, and an independent Bishop-frame core-tube kinetic-energy quadrature for a bounded topology subset.
Evaluate reduced Euler-Lagrange residuals around source-native geometries even when earlier source/geometry gates fail, carrying caveats forward.
Evaluate Legendre-transform closure and reduced Hamiltonian conservation.
Construct finite-difference Hessians under Bishop-frame perturbations and test symmetry/refinement.
Construct Jacobians, extract spectra, and compare oscillatory frequencies with direct reduced integration.
Measure topology stability of spectral ratios without accessing the protected historical target.
Cross-validate simple geometry surrogates against the finite-core energy kernel with topology-grouped holdouts.
Compare preregistered energy-only and geometry-plus-spectrum surrogate families under a complexity penalty.
Freeze a complete target-free topology prediction table and anonymous composite predictions before reveal.
Evaluate protected topology holdout generalization internal to the geometry/energy task; no observed mass targets are used.
Restore SI scales using canonical SST constants in two density lanes and write target-free absolute predictions.
Stress core regularization, discretization, carrier selection, and perturbation amplitude; quantify sensitivity.
Jackknife across provider/lineage groups and report whether findings replicate in independent evidence families.
Assign a blind multi-level classification from all recorded evidence while preserving diagnostic results from failed upstream scientific gates.
